summary: An opponent asks whose name the customer remembers when a repair goes wrong.
realLife: Washington HB 1483 (2025). House opponents argued that poor repairs done elsewhere could damage the manufacturer's reputation.
inGame: needs: a witness raises responsibility for a third-party repair.
gates: A witness raises responsibility for a third-party repair.

turns.what: The customer can identify the last repairer.
turns.pulledBy: The receipt identifies the shop that did the work.
turns.writesBack: The customer takes the complaint there.

turns.what: The shop traces the complaint back to the original product.
